description: Restore an app's DATA from a backup. It does not change which version of the code is deployed — that is percher_rollback, and the two are independent: restoring data leaves today's code live, and rolling back code leaves today's data in place. `source` accepts 'latest', a UTC date 'YYYY-MM-DD', or a full backup id. `dryRun` validates without restoring. Default components: ['appdata', 'pocketbase']. Polls status until terminal (done|rolled_back|failed) — typically 30-120s. Pre-restore data is preserved server-side as `-prerestore` Docker volumes for 24h; manual undo currently requires SSH (dashboard undo coming in B.1.5). Use this for crash recovery or 'restore yesterday'-style requests.
name: percher_restore
